title: Lester Young on why Chu Berry and Ben Webster did not fit
summary: Over red beans and rice, Lester says the engagement will be his if he plays as before.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: -- for himself. He said, "Give him the same thing." He ordered me some. He was very sensitive. So I says, "Okay." I ate red beans and rice, too. So then he says to me, he says, "Have you been listening? Have you been keeping up on your instrument?" So I says, " Well, I've been trying," and I says, "I've been listening." I says, "Oh, yeah, I listen all the time," and I says, "I've been trying." He says, "Well," he says, "if you playing anyway like you were the last time I heard you," he said, "it will be your engagement." He says, -- then he went on to say, "There's a lot of ladies want the engagement," he said, "Lady Berry," talking about -- I says, "Who is that?" He said, "You know Chu Berry?" I says, "Namewise," I says, "Yeah." "And Ben Webster, Lady Webster." He said, "They're good players," he said, "but they don't fit." So he says, "And if you're
playing like you did the last time I heard you, it'll be your engagement."
